name: Cleansing Day
source:
Just another lovely day in the Libretto City Church... As the high priest of the church, it is your job to cleanse those you feel displease the almighty Divinity. 

[From [url=https://liminace.itch.io/cleansing-day]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
又是在剧本城市教堂度过的美好的一天……作为教堂的大祭司，你的工作就是净化那些你觉得令全能神灵不悦的人。

[来自[url=https://liminace.itch.io/cleansing-day]itch.io[/url]]
